name: Arbitrum
shortDescription: ARB is the governance token of the Arbitrum DAO, enabling community participation in the governance of the Arbitrum ecosystem.
description:
Arbitrum is an Ethereum scaling ecosystem designed to support efficient and lower-cost blockchain transactions. ARB serves as the governance token of the Arbitrum DAO, allowing token holders to participate in decentralized governance.

This XITA application is submitted independently by a token holder to propose additional cross-chain accessibility and visibility for ARB. It does not represent an official application or endorsement by the Arbitrum Foundation or DAO.
